data.title: 黑歌 · 和风缘侧的烤鱼投喂
data.description: 夏日午后微风吹拂的木质缘侧上，黑歌盘腿斜倚在廊柱边。她用筷子剔好香脆烤鱼肉送到你唇边，两只黑色猫耳欢快抖动，双尾在地板上轻拍，眉眼满是娇媚笑意。
data.location: traditional wooden veranda overlooking sunny Japanese garden
data.action: feeding grilled fish to partner with chopsticks, cat ears twitching happily, twin cat tails wagging, playful golden eyes
data.lighting: warm dappled afternoon sunshine through leafy bamboo trees
data.mood: lazing domestic bliss, feline charm, playful couple sweetness
data.promptProse: Sitting on a wooden veranda in a loose black kimono, Kuroka feeds grilled fish to her partner, cat ears twitching with playful golden eyes.
data.animaCaption: Kuroka feeding grilled fish on a breezy wooden veranda with twitching cat ears.
